audit_items.proof_trace: The primary kiosk insertion path is the SECURITY DEFINER RPC `record_attendance_by_card(p_card_id text)`, which uses `v_now := now()` (PostgreSQL server clock) and accepts no timestamp parameter — clients cannot supply one. All secondary server-action paths (`actions.ts`, `attendance.service.ts`) are Next.js `'use server'` functions that compute timestamps via `new Date()` server-side. Direct client inserts are blocked by `REVOKE ALL ON attendance.attendances FROM anon` and the absence of any authenticated INSERT RLS policy.
